correctness.rationale: The grounded cyclic Laplacian has an exact periodic Green kernel for every integer n>=3 and real t>0. Its positive monotone entries give absolute column sums A and B for the two edge types, with the complementary projections exchanging them. The spectral representation makes t*g0 strictly increasing in conductance, and the explicit Green expression makes it strictly decreasing in cycle length, proving a unique increasing transition to 4/3. The asymptotic estimates follow from the same closed kernel. Exact matrix replay passed 63 rational parameter instances, 882 columns and 18 radical Green identities; this is supplemental finite evidence, not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The verified 2023 Banach-space lead establishes the graph projection framework, while the inspected resistance papers give inverse/potential information. The final claim instead computes all absolute columns of the conductance-normalized weighted-wheel orthogonal pair and proves unique moving edge-orbit thresholds, a specific statement not found in the checked resources. Unindexed equivalents remain a documented risk; failed searches are not taken as a proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: The claim completely evaluates natural endpoint Banach operator norms for a two-parameter conductance-normalized wheel family and gives an exact moving optimizer bifurcation. Distinct cut/cycle maximizing orbits and the increasing threshold with nontrivial limit 4/3 are mathematically motivated structural phenomena, not isolated recomputation of effective resistances or arbitrary finite slices. The parity-sensitive exponential approach to limiting norms provides additional exact quantitative structure.
